_comment: Per-vocation auto-AI profiles for non-active party members (LIV-9 schema; LIV-8 WS5 content). Every non-active ally reads its profile here; no vocation names are hardcoded in JS.

_semantics.preferredAbilities: Ordered ability ids; the first usable one (off cooldown, in range, resources available) wins.
_semantics.followDistance: Tiles the member trails the active member while no target is acquired.
_semantics.engageRadius: Distance (tiles, from the member) at which it acquires the nearest hostile and closes to fight.
_semantics.castRange: Preferred combat distance; the member closes to / retreats to this while engaged.
_semantics.retreatHpPct: HP fraction (0-1) below which the member disengages and returns to formation.
_semantics.retargetSec: Minimum seconds the member commits to a target before switching.
_semantics.healAlliesWhenHurt: Support flag: prefer a heal when any party member is below the hurt threshold.

_design: Roles stay distinct: Fighter/Paladin hold the line (follow 1, melee), Archer/Magician fight from the back (follow 3). Retreat thresholds track fragility - Magician (60 HP) disengages earliest at 0.35, Fighter (140 HP) holds latest at 0.20. Paladin is the only healing profile. Rationale: docs/design/game-design.md 8.1.

magician._note: Squishiest backline (60 HP): disengages earliest so an artillery telegraph cannot one-shot it. Opens with Beam (4-tile, 20 dmg), fills with Spark, and takes the longest to retarget because it commits to a cast.

archer._note: Longest reach (6). Opens with Power Shot (4s cooldown) before Bow Shot so the auto-AI does not drain the party's arrow stock; that ordering is the ammo-economy guard rail.

fighter._note: Frontline anchor (140 HP): intercepts out to 3 tiles, holds to 20% HP, and retargets fastest so Cleave lands on clusters rather than a single body.

paladin._note: Melee anchor and the party's only healer: Holy Prayer (healRadius 6) finds the most-injured ally, otherwise Holy Strike. Retarget 1.2 keeps it responsive to a dropping ally.
